summary: This standards-track document defines a vendor-specific protocol on the TRILL RBridge Channel. The RBridge Channel is a general mechanism for sending typed messages between RBridges. This lets vendors carry their own messages over it.

eli5.summary: A shared mailroom lets companies drop in notes of their own with their company stamp. Vendors can send private notes between TRILL switches.

questions: what is the trill vendor-specific rbridge channel
how can vendors add custom trill messages
